units.source_text: 箱根首次对弈那天，中途暂停后，大竹七段刚返回自己的房间，

en.t: On the day of the first match at Hakone, after the game was suspended midway, Seventh-dan Otake had just returned to his room,

units.source_text: 就对女佣说：“要是有棋盘，拿一个来。”

en.t: when he said to the maid, "If there is a go board, bring one here."

units.source_text: 他像是在分析刚才的战局，传来了放棋子的声音。

en.t: He seemed to be analyzing the position from just before, and the sound of stones being placed could be heard.

units.source_text: 名人也听见了，他却马上换了便服，无拘无束地出现在工作人员的房间里。

en.t: The Master heard it too, but he immediately changed into informal clothes and appeared at ease in the staff room.

units.source_text: 他让两子，同我下起连珠棋来，只战了五六个回合，他就轻易地把我击败了。

en.t: He gave me a two-stone handicap and began playing renju with me, but after only five or six moves he easily defeated me.

units.source_text: “让两子有点闹着玩，真没意思，还是到浦上你的房间去下将棋吧。”

en.t: "Giving a two-stone handicap feels a bit like fooling around and is no fun. Let us go to your room, Uragami, and play shogi instead."

units.source_text: 名人说着兴冲冲地站起来走了。

en.t: As he said this, the Master rose eagerly and left.

units.source_text: 于是他同岩本六段下，让了飞车，晚餐时分才告暂停。

en.t: So he played against Sixth-dan Iwamoto, giving him a rook handicap, and they did not stop until dinnertime.

units.source_text: 六段微带醉意，大模大样地盘腿而坐，一边拍打着裸露的大腿。

en.t: The sixth-dan player, slightly drunk, sat cross-legged with an air of importance, slapping his bare thighs as he did so.
He had lost to the Master.
